scope: Independent source/materiality review of four held complete provider reports; public package contains selected excerpts only.
review_status: Source/materiality check passed for a narrow metadata supplement. Public package acceptance remains a maintainer decision.

source_review.method: A separate reviewer directly decompressed and parsed the four already-held gzip JSONs; complete-source SHA256 and byte counts matched their acquisition manifest. No report refresh, target/proxy call, database read or acquisition-script execution.
verified: Complete original report hashes and byte counts
Exactly one HTTP event per report
Submitted URL, observed URL and raw request line agree on the complete five query parameters
Three raw count/schema headers occur exactly once at the stated line numbers
HTTP-event date, report date and response Date header remain separate
Response body data null, zero decoded size and empty-content hash
Acquisition manifest time records workflow start before cache check/request waiting

issue_context.classification: Existing retained metadata clarification; no accepted answer or resolution.

portable_verification: The selected file hash verifies package bytes. Pointers, values, source mappings and clock distinctions can be checked against pinned assertions. Full-source hashes remain provenance assertions tied to the independent review; omitted full originals cannot be rehashed or fully checked by this portable verifier.
unresolved: All numeric completion values and readable historical bodies
All top5/top3 row-wise reconciliation and standalone Year enforcement
Historical rank, tie and year-span behavior
Actor identity, receipt, use or causation
broader_worker_wiki_database_claims: Contextual limits only; not independently re-extracted in this review and not included as new package evidence.
